title: Locale-based Content
description: Shows different blocks to visitors in different locales. Everyone sees the default content unless a locale override matches their locale; the first matching override replaces the default content in full. Wrap only the blocks that differ between locales — anything the same everywhere belongs outside this wrapper. Field-level translation (localised fields on a block) is separate and still applies to whichever block is shown.

defaultContent.title: Default content
defaultContent.description: Shown to every locale that has no matching override below. Leave empty to show nothing by default, for content that should only appear in some locales.

localeOverrides.title: Locale overrides
localeOverrides.description: Content that replaces the default for specific locales. The first override whose locales include the visitor's locale is used; the rest are ignored.

locales.title: Locales
locales.description: The locales this override applies to, as Amplience locale codes — e.g. fr-FR or de-DE. Each must be a locale the site is configured to serve.

items.title: Locale code
items.description: A language, with an optional region: fr, or fr-FR.

content.title: Content
content.description: Replaces the default content for these locales. Leave empty to hide the content in these locales.
